format: html

library(tidyverse)

```{r}
personal_data<-read.csv("~/Downloads/Mary_Agou_personal_visualisation_journey.csv")

cleaned_data<-personal_data|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Shopping / services"="Shopping"))|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Transfer / person-to-person payment"="money transfer"))|>
   mutate(category=recode(category,"Uncategorized purchase"="Shopping"))|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Remittance / money transfer"="money transfer"))|>
   mutate(category=recode(category,"Pharmacy / health"="pharmacy"))|>
   mutate(category=recode(category,"Credit card payment"="Credit_payment"))|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Transfer / cash management"="savings"))|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Government / services"="g_services"))|>
  mutate(amount_usd=abs(amount_usd))|>
  
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Food / dining"="food"))|>
  mutate(category=recode(category,"Donation / organization (verify)"="donations"))|>
  filter(category!="Account transfer")|>
  mutate(date=as.Date(date))
  
cleaned_data
```



```{r}
cleaned_data|>
  group_by(category)|>
  ggplot(aes(x=category,y=amount_usd))+
  geom_boxplot()
```




```{r}

cleaned_data|>
  ggplot(aes(x=date,y=amount_usd,colour = category))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_colour_hue()

```

```{r}
cleaned_data|>
  ggplot(aes(x=date,y=amount_usd,colour = category))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100))+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
  "red", "blue", "green", "orange", "purple",
  "brown", "pink", "cyan", "gold"
))

```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = amount_usd, colour = category)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +

  # Y-axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +

  # Colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "red", "blue", "green", "orange", "purple",
    "brown", "pink", "cyan", "gold"
  )) +

  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "My Financial Transactions Over Time for a month",
    subtitle = "Money transfers account for the largest share of my total spending.",
    x = "Transaction Date",
    y = "Transaction Amount (USD)",
    colour = "Transaction Category",
    caption = "Source: Personal financial transaction records,Createdby:Mary Agou,Created on:November 4th 2026."
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 16, face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, colour = "gray40"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 11, face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9, colour = "gray40"
    )
  )
```
